package.name: encino_waves
package.description:
Vendored Apache-2.0 EncinoWaves ocean spectrum library (Christopher Jon Horvath, 2015) with the FFTW backend replaced by an Eigen::FFT shim so the library lifts cleanly into VRX's Apache-2.0 dependency envelope.
Implements the spectra and propagation pipeline from Horvath's 2015 DigiPro paper "Empirical directional wave spectra for computer graphics" — TMA / JONSWAP / Pierson-Moskowitz spectra, Hasselmann directional spread, capillary / deep / finite-depth dispersion, and the Tessendorf chop-aware tangent/normal computation.
package.author: Christopher Jon Horvath (upstream)
